AUDIENCE & TESTABILITY:
API audience: ADVANCED/LOW-LEVEL
Harness testability: TESTABLE-WITH-LOW-LEVEL-CONSTRUCTION
Scoring recommendation: include only in advanced/internal bucket

ROOT CAUSE:
The documentation contains an error regarding the exact class name of the numpy backend. It incorrectly instructs the user to assert the type name as `"NumpyBackend"` (lowercase 'p'), but the actual class name returned by the library is `"NumPyBackend"` (capital 'P'). 

CORRECT USAGE:
```python
backend_ = Backend("numpy")
actual_backend = backend_.get_backend()

assert actual_backend is not None
assert type(actual_backend).__name__ == "NumPyBackend"
```

REQUIRED TYPES & IMPORTS:
tslearn.backend.Backend

DOC MUST SAY:
- The exact class name of the numpy backend implementation is `NumPyBackend` (with a capital 'P').
- When dynamically checking the type name of the returned backend, assert against `"NumPyBackend"`, not `"NumpyBackend"`.
